name: Dock
description: A centred bottom dock: app launcher, Overview, Komble, one box per workspace with its windows, your minimized windows, downloads from ewe Browser, and the dock items other plugins provide. On the main screen, on every screen, or on none.
author: prj786

settings.label: Intelligent auto-hide
settings.description: Slides away when a window needs the space; comes back when you point at the bottom edge.

settings.label: Icon size
settings.description: How big the dock buttons and workspace groups are: 40, 48 or 64 px.

settings.label: Show the dock on
settings.description: Primary: the main screen only. All: every screen; the others get a small dock with the plugin buttons (Phone, Music, Places…), that screen's workspaces and the windows minimized there. None: no dock.
